CustomField.description: Set by Apex (LeadTriggerHandler) using the Enrollment Hours business hours, so weekends and holidays are skipped. Replaced the earlier formula version of this field.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Displays the date and time the next outreach attempt is due: the next working day after the lead is created, 2 days after the first outreach attempt (always leaving at least one working day), and 7 days after the second. A due date that falls on a weekend or holiday moves to the next working day at 9 AM. The field is blank when the record is closed or all outreach attempts are complete.
CustomField.label: Next Follow-Up Due
